_readme: Optional per-repo overrides. Any field set here wins over what the build finds on GitHub. Fields: title, fa (Persian title), category (studio|ext|cinema|pub|fork|other), description, tags, live (a URL, or false to show no live link), hide (true to leave the repo out).

angle.title: Contact Angle
angle.description: Grows Islamic star patterns from a plain tiling. Two rays leave each edge midpoint and meet as stars; tune the contact angle, offset and rotation, then animate the construction.

Iqa.title: Iqa Rhythm Studio
Iqa.description: Build rhythmic cycles from Arab, Turkish and Persian traditions on four drum lanes, write A, B and fill variations, and export audio or MIDI.

Specimen.title: Specimen Loop
Specimen.description: Turns one photo into a seamless liquid-warp loop with tracker labels and glitch bursts. Every term in the motion formula is a slider; exports MP4 or GIF.

synth.title: Equation Synth
synth.description: Write y = f(x) and a dot sweeps along x, playing the curve's height as pitch. Layer equations like instruments and save MP4 or WAV.

boresh.title: Boresh
boresh.description: A sliced portrait studio. Cut, mirror, weave or mosaic a portrait into strips that breathe on a sine loop. Everything runs locally.

qali-clock.title: Qāli-ye Emruz
qali-clock.description: The rug of today: a clock drawn as a carpet on a loom, weaving itself through the hours. A new rug begins at midnight.

prompt-lens.title: PromptLens
prompt-lens.description: Right-click any image to reverse-engineer a generation prompt in the grammar of Midjourney, Seedance, Kling, Flux or SDXL. Bring your own key.

outfit.title: Outfit Lens
outfit.description: Reads any outfit with Gemini and builds ready-to-run shopping searches for every piece: dress, jacket, shoes.

Doblaj-.title: Doblaj
Doblaj-.description: Live Persian dubbing for any video in Chrome. Listens to the tab, detects the language and speaks it back in Persian a few seconds later.

redline.title: Redline
redline.description: A bias checker for Persian news. Highlights loaded wording and swaps it for neutral phrasing, with an optional AI review pass.

ketabjoo.title: Ketabjoo
ketabjoo.description: Searches Persian book archives across Telegram channels, with a direct link to each original message.

Mowj.title: Mowj Rooms
Mowj.description: Listen to YouTube Music in sync with friends. No audio streaming: each browser plays, Mowj keeps everyone on the same beat.

navayab.title: Navāyab
navayab.description: Name the tune before the clock drains. A listening game with three levels, a live shared leaderboard and a full Persian interface.

Pinpoint.title: Pinpoint: Capital Hunt
Pinpoint.description: Twelve cities, one unlabeled world map, fifteen seconds each. Precision scores, hesitation costs, one miss resets your streak.

pinpoint-iran.title: Pinpoint Iran
pinpoint-iran.description: The Iran edition: twelve Iranian cities from Tehran to Bijar, no labels. The target radius shrinks as your streak grows.

Iching-extension.title: I Ching
Iching-extension.description: An animated three-coin casting ritual, all 64 hexagrams in King Wen order, changing lines and a private casting record. Fully offline.

sieve-of-fortune.title: Sieve of Fortune
sieve-of-fortune.description: A daily lucky number drawn from Ulam's 1956 sieve, shaped by date, season, time and place, with the full reasoning shown.

tab-activity.title: Tab Activity
tab-activity.description: A private time dial for your browsing: tracks the time you actively spend on each site, entirely on your device.

remains-of-today.title: What Remains of Today
remains-of-today.description: A calm countdown ring in the toolbar showing how much of today, the week, month, quarter and year is left.

world-ambient.title: World Ambient
world-ambient.description: Curated ambient playlists while you browse. Pick a mood, press play, drift.

clip.title: Clip Stack
clip.description: Keeps your last ten copied items and drops them into any field with one shortcut. Local-only and password-safe.

Ambient-Cue.title: Ambient Cue
Ambient-Cue.description: Background music that shifts with the time of day, your activity and your job, pulled from a track catalog you host and update.

film.title: Film Credits Search
film.description: Searches Iranian film credits kept as one CSV per film. A GitHub Action rebuilds the index on every push, so new films appear automatically.

subs.title: Subtitle Search
subs.description: Full-text search inside the Persian SRT subtitles of Iranian films, from Ejareh-neshinha to Mouse.

itube.title: Reel Archive
itube.description: Searches film lists harvested from 25 Persian YouTube channels and plays matches inline. One static page, no build step.

cinema.title: Poster Index
cinema.description: Poster index with per-film search pages built from frames and text, starting with Marjan and Tehran 57.

televika.title: Movie Archive
televika.description: A searchable local archive of 706 movie stream links with poster art.

m3u8.title: M3U8 Player
m3u8.description: An HLS player with a built-in list of streams for classic Iranian films.

Harvester.title: Video Harvester
Harvester.description: Point it at a YouTube channel and get every title and video URL back as a clean list. Your API key stays in the page.

films.title: CSV Search Template
films.description: The reusable template behind the credits search: drop CSVs into data/, push, and GitHub Pages rebuilds the index.

eproof.title: persian_proof
eproof.description: Proofreads large collections of Persian ePubs for spelling, grammar and typography, producing a browsable report and safely corrected copies.

skill.title: Skill Archive
skill.description: A working library of skill files for Claude, including Farnevis and Seedance Director, readable in the browser and downloadable.

afarahani-com.title: afarahani.com mirror
afarahani-com.description: A static mirror of Ali Farahani's Wix site, captured with wget and hosted on GitHub Pages.

MoneyPrinterTurbo.title: MoneyPrinterTurbo
MoneyPrinterTurbo.description: Fork of harry0703/MoneyPrinterTurbo: give it a topic and it writes the script, matches footage and adds subtitles and music for a short video.

hermes-literary-translation-mastery.title: Hermes Book Translator
hermes-literary-translation-mastery.description: Fork of a desktop suite for translating books, novels and articles into literary Persian.

Lissajous.title: Lissajous Lab
Lissajous.description: Feed one sine wave into each axis and a dot draws a Lissajous figure. Change the frequency ratio and phase, add a trace pen or drift, and play the curve as stereo tones.

Proportion.title: Proportion Studio
Proportion.description: Set up a fashion shoot, then push any body part or garment bigger or smaller with sliders. The image prompt rewrites itself as you go, for Midjourney or Stable Diffusion.

Surreal.title: Surreal Prompt Studio
Surreal.description: Builds surreal image prompts from a device, subject, meaning and medium. Fix the parts you care about, leave the rest to chance, and generate up to six ideas per run.
